upstream.license: MIT; upstream assets retain their individual notices

modes.train: JAX batched PPO; one learner seat per game, alternating at episode reset
modes.evaluate: both physical seats for each map/opponent; no shaping; player-visible policy
modes.profile: random legal-action simulator separately from current/history inference + PPO

heldout_opponents: upstream MIT HunterAgent (never used by train/development eval)

score.faults: illegal actions, unresolved games, checksum/rules mismatches and simulator exceptions fail validation; never convert to policy loss

budgets.unit: allocated worker wall seconds / 3600 on one GPU machine with fixed attached CPU and RAM
budgets.supervisor: lease.py persists cumulative elapsed worker seconds and terminates at deadline; external scheduler defines actual hardware reservation
budgets.sample_limit: optional bounded local smoke only; not a substitute for allocated-worker budget

caveats: Small 8x8 1v1 standard on the pinned classic rules: fog, general trade enabled, no build-castles or deathtouch, 400-tick cap.
Same generator settings as the archived generals-research-1v1-8x8-v1 task; a new id because source, codec declaration and bindings differ.
Not live generals.io matchmaking and not the full-size task: full-v2 rates, checkpoints and reference bots do not qualify here.
Only local CPU validation of this ruleset so far; no GPU throughput or playing-strength measurement.

rules.timeout_score: draw; zero terminal reward; bootstrap final visible value in training
rules.reward: capture +/-1; optional public potential shaping only in training
rules.range_semantics: Mountain and castle counts inclusive; castle army upper bound exclusive, as in pinned upstream
rules.observation_codec: 9 spatial + 5 public scalar broadcast planes, normalized; no memory

historical_standard: benchmark.json (8x8-v1) and benchmark-full-v2.json (full-size, git tag full-size-20261113) and their evidence are immutable records, not current qualification
